prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were consistently too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
Home wait_info changes showed no clear effect across 3 tests.
Reordering sign-in showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Choose_path layout changes did not improve conversion across 2 tests, with significant layout changes hurting performance.
Evidence is still thin for adoption/new_screen, adoption/redesign, choose_path/copy, finish/hint, finish/notification, and finish/redesign, as each kind has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -1.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, copy: -0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: -2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, hint: -1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: -3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: -0.6% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +1.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Scroll Intro Screen Redesign: Redesigns the initial story screen using a narrative scroll layout with interactive mascot animation components. (why: Choose_path stage mean time is 514s indicating users get stalled during initial orientation; 23.8% drop off before path selection.)
1: [home, hint] Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting Hint on Waiting Screen: Adds a persistent hint on the waiting screen explaining how to verify screen rendering and system tray placement. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not showing on desktop or app failing to open during launch, and home step median duration is 201s.)
2: [sign_in, copy] Instant Sync Benefit Sign-In Copy: Updates sign-in screen headline and body copy to emphasize automatic cloud backup and cross-device pet restoration. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% with a mean duration of 567s. Clear benefit copy reduces sign-in hesitation.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Hatching Animation on Waiting Screen: Adds an animated pet egg hatching component on the waiting screen while background asset generation completes. (why: Waiting screen has high drop-off (81.3% step conv) and median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s). Visual progress entertains users while loading.)
4: [finish, notification] Desktop Pet Launch Notification Prompt: Enables desktop notification toggle on the home intro screen so users get alerted as soon as the pet spawns. (why: Finish step conversion is 64.8% and users are confused when the pet does not appear on desktop immediately.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Clear Path Selection Purpose Copy: Replaces the choose path headline and body with explicit explanations of premade vs custom pet options. (why: 23.8% drop-off occurs at choose_path step, with a high mean time of 514s indicating path confusion.)

scores.note: Major layout/redesign on choose_path has previously hurt conversion.
Both support tickets and funnel stats support adding desktop rendering hints.
Config-only copy change targeting sign-in hesitation.
Home wait_info modifications showed no clear effect across 3 past tests.
Targets finish step drop-off; notification changes showed positive lift in initial test.
Config-only copy update on choose_path, though past copy test showed slight decline.
